incidents.description: tools.exec.mode=allowlist made every agent turn fail at preflight before any command ran; ask and auto both work and ask was kept
the exec allowlist entries name the script path, so the agent's own "node <script> …" invocation did not match and still raised an approval card
skills.entries.openmausbot-launcher.env is not applied to commands run through the Codex harness: the binary check failed until the command carried an explicit env prefix
incidents.resolved: worked around with the env prefix

incidents.description: two escalation requests in CLI turn 2 expired unanswered after the full 120 s window because the operator's resolver filtered on a summary that the card truncates
incidents.resolved: turn 3 resolved every card within about 5 s

incidents.description: doctor --server reported "nothing answers at http://127.0.0.1:8899" for a healthy server because the driver's health probe turns a network error into null, so the check cannot tell a blocked socket from a dead server
incidents.note: observed limitation of the driver, recorded for a later fix

incidents.description: dsh shell subprocesses run in their own PID namespace, so the driver cannot verify the server process identity: doctor --server returns provider-keys unknown and identity false, and status exits 3
